scripts.dev: concurrently --names "CLIENT,SERVER" --prefix-colors "cyan,green" "cd client && npm run dev" "cd server && npm run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently --names "CLIENT,SERVER" --prefix-colors "cyan,green" "cd client && npm run start" "cd server && npm run start"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
